limitations: One owned frozen diagnostic input graph, two original runs and one candidate run at actual subgroup32. No other widths/drivers or dispatch corpus admitted.
The interval selection/provenance proof is for these frozen inputs; actual as-submitted descriptors and native candidate classification remain unestablished.
Actual descriptor-handle identity was checked in this independent host, not integrated into the live renderer.
No shader timestamp query was issued. Process elapsed wall includes compilation, resources, submission, waiting and complete export; it is not GPU execution timing. Compiler Cycles is an estimate.
Complete buffer equality does not establish image-quality, gameplay, stability across scenes, native-feature parity or FPS.

Known-process scans passed before each launch, with a separate root exclusive lease. The scanner does not exhaustively exclude renamed/unknown background GPU applications. Prior static compile-scan uncertainty remains documented separately.

preserved02_comparison.scope: Only baseline-once separately reopened both preserved02 baseline output sets. New common23 profile/helper identity remains distinct; earlier evidence is not relabeled.

result.original_owners_comparison: Every original buffer byte is represented by a checked complete-file SHA256, with exact file size and receipt identity.
result.record_oracle: Full independent record+guards equal immutable initial owner; native and Python checks both passed.

scope: Three separately authorized single-dispatch owned frozen-input observations: original once, original repeat, nonuniform-array candidate once. No runtime speed, live rendering or FPS result.
